candidates.query: SELECT ?o WHERE { ?o a :Order . ?s a :Shipment . ?st a :Status . ?st :name ?st_name . ?o :DEPENDS_ON ?s . ?st :HAS_STATUS ?s . FILTER(?st_name = 'Delayed') }
SELECT ?p ?o WHERE { ?o a :Order . ?s a :Shipment . ?st a :Status . ?st :name ?st_name . ?p a :Product . ?o :DEPENDS_ON ?s . ?st :HAS_STATUS ?s . ?p :STOCKS ?st . FILTER(?st_name = 'Delayed') }
SELECT ?f ?o WHERE { ?o a :Order . ?s a :Shipment . ?st a :Status . ?st :name ?st_name . ?f a :Fab . ?o :DEPENDS_ON ?s . ?st :HAS_STATUS ?s . ?f :PRODUCES ?st . FILTER(?st_name = 'Delayed') }
SELECT ?m ?o WHERE { ?o a :Order . ?s a :Shipment . ?st a :Status . ?st :name ?st_name . ?m a :Material . ?o :DEPENDS_ON ?s . ?st :HAS_STATUS ?s . ?m :SUPPLIES ?st . FILTER(?st_name = 'Delayed') }

SELECT ?ps ?o WHERE { ?o a :Order . ?s a :Shipment . ?st a :Status . ?st :name ?st_name . ?ps a :ProcessStep . ?o :DEPENDS_ON ?s . ?st :HAS_STATUS ?s . ?ps :USED_IN ?st . FILTER(?st_name = 'Delayed') }
